services.title: 15-Day Free Returns
services.description: Request for a free return within 15 days and get a full refund*. Applicable to selected items. Electronic Category products must remain SEALED (i.e., the seal is not broken, been tampered with, or altered). Exclusion Applied. View T&C here.

services.title: Cash on Delivery
services.description: 1. Shopee offers Cash On Delivery (COD) in Malaysia for Doorstep Delivery or orders under RM500.  2. You order will be assigned to Shopee Supported Logistics partners for delivery.  3. Pay cash to the courier upon parcel delivery.  4. Do note that the amount payable will be rounded to the nearest 5 cents.  5. A reminder to beware of fraudulent behaviors, you do not need to make any payments directly to seller for Cash On Delivery orders.
